final: SELECT SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM (SELECT state_name, state_total, state_total / all_total AS share, overall_average_share FROM (SELECT state_name, state_total, SUM(state_total) OVER () AS all_total, AVG(state_total * 1.0 / SUM(state_total) OVER ()) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, '') AS state_name, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, '')))) WHERE share > overall_average_share
